People's Majlis Committee Minutes

16th Meeting of the Decentralisation Committee

21 October 2026

Meeting venue: People's Majlis (Committee Room 8)
Start time: 11:45

{Presiding: Committee Chair; Member for Machangolhi Medhu constituency, Ahmed Dhameer}

Chair:

بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم. The 16th meeting of the Decentralisation Committee of the third session of the 20th People's Majlis. This meeting is being held in Committee Room 8. 21 October 2026, Wednesday. Present in the Committee at this time are the Honourable Member for Bilehdhoo constituency Ahmed Aslam, the Honourable Member for Addu Meedhoo constituency Abdul Rahman, the Honourable Member for Nilandhoo constituency Fathimath Sauda, the Honourable Member for Naifaru constituency Yaaseen Abdulla, the Honourable Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed, and myself (Dhameer). Submitted to the Committee today is the reply we sought from the relevant institutions, to which we wrote in connection with a letter the Committee received earlier. That is the letter sent by Mohamed Waheed, Gurahalu / HDh. Hirimaradhoo, on 25 June 2026. The replies to that letter have now been received by us from the Local Government Authority, the Finance Ministry and the Civil Service Commission. So, Committee members have received these letters through the group, have they not? I would like the secretariat to give a brief summary of these letters. The Honourable Member for Ungoofaaru constituency Ibrahim Shifaz has joined our Committee. The Honourable Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed.

Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed:

Yes! Thank you, Chair. In the matter now submitted, the former Secretary General of the HDh. Hanimaadhoo Council office, Mohamed Asif, matters concerning him have been submitted. So, the Civil Service Commission has now also given its reply, saying that, as there were allegations against him in that matter and he had also breached the code of conduct, and as this was proven to the Commission, he has been dismissed from his job and a letter has been sent [to him]. So, I therefore propose that this matter be filed at this point. Thank you.

Chair:

The Honourable Member for Naifaru constituency Yaaseen Abdulla.

Member for Naifaru constituency Yaaseen Abdulla:

I second the proposal made by Hassan Waheed to proceed in that way.

Chair:

I will put to a vote the proposal made by the Honourable Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed and seconded by the Honourable Member for Naifaru constituency Yaaseen Abdulla. (Voting) Yes! Passed unanimously by the Committee, to file this matter as it is a concluded matter. Next, there are the annual reports sent to the Committee. Among them is the annual report sent by the Malhosmadulu South Atoll Council. One sent by Thiladhunmathi North. One sent by Miladhunmadulu South. One sent by Huvadhu Atoll South. And also Malhosmadulu North, and Malhosmadulu South, and the Malhosmadulu South Atoll Council office, and the Thiladhunmathi North Maarandhoo Council. In fact, these reports are not reports that these offices are required to send to this Committee. They are actually required to be sent to the Local Government Authority. And the Local Government Authority has also given us a presentation in connection with the reports. That has now been completed. In addition to these, there is also one submitted to the Ministry of Cities, Local Government and Public Works. And that ministry has now also been dissolved. So, I will give the floor to the Honourable Member for Nilandhoo constituency Fathimath Sauda to say something on this matter.

Member for Nilandhoo constituency Fathimath Sauda:

The reports submitted are not reports that this Committee is required to review. These are not reports required to be submitted here. So, I propose that these reports be filed. I make this proposal because when the LGA sends us its report, it submits it together with all of these reports, you see. So, that is what I propose.

Chair:

The Honourable Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed.

Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed:

Yes! I second the proposal made by the Honourable Member for Nilandhoo constituency. As it has been proposed to this Committee that these matters now be filed, I would like to say that I second it in that way.

Chair:

Yes! I will put to a vote filing these matters, as proposed by the Honourable Member for Nilandhoo constituency Fathimath Sauda and seconded by the Honourable Member for Vilifushi constituency Hassan Waheed. (Voting) Yes! Passed unanimously by the Committee. So, with the items on today's set agenda completed, I will close the Committee for today at this point. Thank you very much to all members.
